release_notes: V14.44 build 261 is a revision-only OTA validation release based on build 260. It retains the proven OLED242-style HTTP/1.1 firmware-download transport, manual HTTPS redirect handling, extended TLS handshake allowance, binary download headers and enhanced Serial diagnostics introduced in build 260. No Nightscout, display, alarm, trend, buzzer, screen-orientation, Wi-Fi, Web UI, mDNS or configuration behaviour has changed.
